readouts.note: CDU line 1, pilot seat. The CH-47F CDU is 14 lines of 24, the MCDU's own grid, so line n sits on row n. Each line has a twin, PLT_CDU_LINEn_COLOR, one letter per character; colours.codes says what the letters mean. A space there leaves the field's own colour, white.
Even lines 2 to 12 are the CDU's small labels, so they draw in the small font; line 14, the scratchpad, is large. Split taken from WCtrlDcsBiosBridge's CH-47F listener.

DCS-BIOS sends the CDU's symbols as single bytes above ASCII (CH-47F.lua, cdu_replace_map), and the braces as arrows. replace turns each into the character whose glyph the CH-47F font draws for it: the arrows, the check mark (box slot), the up-down arrow (Delta slot), and ? in the % slot.
CDU line 1, copilot seat. Same cells as the pilot's line 1: seat picks which station's CDU is on the glass, so the MCDU follows you when you change seats.
